attractions.name: Badami Cave Temples
attractions.description: Complex of 6th-century rock-cut caves with sculptures of Shiva, Vishnu and Jain Tirthankaras, carved pillars, cliffside locations and sweeping views.
tips: Best suited if you leave early and enjoy longer days of exploration
Adds about 2 hours as a one-way detour from the Hampi–Solapur route
